lore.intersolarsystem.terminal.0: Day 1. The last supply flight is down. Twelve of us. The view of Earth is the worst part: it used to be blue.
lore.intersolarsystem.terminal.1: Day 212. The Ark ships need helium-3. We are mining the regolith around the clock. The ilmenite gives us oxygen.
lore.intersolarsystem.terminal.2: Day 390. Ark-3 left orbit today. There was no seat for us. They said the next ship would come back for the base.
lore.intersolarsystem.terminal.3: Day 412. Hydroponics failing. Three of us left. If you are reading this, the codes for the seed vault are in the Svalbard log. Take the helium. Go.
message.intersolarsystem.barren_soil: The dead soil is barren: plants only grow in a ship's farm

message.intersolarsystem.travel.signal.0: ...Ark-3 to any station. Proxima burn complete. Crew in cold sleep. We will call when we wake...
message.intersolarsystem.travel.signal.1: ...the seed vaults are sealed. If anyone hears this, the codes are in the Svalbard log...
message.intersolarsystem.travel.signal.2: ...it is not the dust. Repeat, it is not the dust. Do not open the...
message.intersolarsystem.travel.signal.3: ...Lunar Base Tranquility, day 412. Hydroponics failing. Three of us left...
message.intersolarsystem.travel.signal.4: ...a carrier tone from beyond Neptune, repeating every 4.2 hours. It is not ours...
message.intersolarsystem.travel.signal.5: ...to whoever kept the lights on down there: thank you. Ark-1 is leaving orbit...
message.intersolarsystem.travel.signal.6: ...Proxima b, twilight belt. Water confirmed. Air... we are not sure about the air...
message.intersolarsystem.travel.signal.7: ...this is an automated beacon. The station is empty. Take what you need...
message.intersolarsystem.travel.solar_fl: Solar flare! Radiation surges through the electronics and life support
message.intersolarsystem.travel.wreck: A drifting wreck within reach: salvage tumbles in through the airlock
